bullets.text: Work Context in GitHub Copilot - **GitHub Copilot SDK** enhances developer productivity by embedding work context directly into coding environments.
Securing AI Agents - **Microsoft Defender** introduces real-time protection for AI agents to mitigate risks during runtime.
Windows 365 for Agents - **Windows 365** now supports autonomous AI agents, enhancing workflow automation and security.
Introducing winapp CLI - The **Windows App Development CLI** simplifies app development across various frameworks and toolchains.
Integrated Security Success - **Microsoft Security** showcases how integrated security is essential for AI transformation in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements are rolling out in **Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 26220.7653**.
AiTM Phishing Campaign - A multi-stage **phishing** campaign exploiting **SharePoint** highlights the need for advanced security measures.
Notepad and Paint Updates - **Notepad** and **Paint** receive updates enhancing functionality for Windows Insiders.
Xbox App on Arm PCs - The **Xbox app** is now available on Arm-based **Windows 11 PCs**, expanding gaming accessibility.
AI Agents Security Posture - **Microsoft Defender** emphasizes the importance of securing AI agents to mitigate emerging risks.
